strip.range: {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} from {start}

empty.title: No hotels tracked yet
empty.body: Add your hotel and your competitors in <link>Settings › Hotels</link>. The next scan will fill the dashboard.

snapshot.title: Tonight's comp set at a glance
snapshot.info: Comp set competitors on Booking.com. Rooms left only adds up competitors for which Booking.com shows an exact count; rates are each hotel's lowest advertised rate while still on sale.
snapshot.roomsLeftTitle: Sum of {known}/{observed} competitors with exact counts
snapshot.medianRateTitle: {price}: median lowest advertised rate of {count, plural, one {# competitor} other {# competitors}} on sale
snapshot.restrictedTitle: Competitors selling only 2+ night stays or closed to arrival: still selling, not counted as sold out

tight.title: Competitors sold out or nearly
tight.info: Competitors sold out or with ≤3 rooms left out of the competitors observed (x/N) on Booking.com. A percentage and level (high from 75, moderate from 50) are only shown with {min} or more competitors; otherwise just x/N.
tight.caption: {tight}/{observed} · {level}

advertised.title: Avg advertised rate (comp)
advertised.info: Median of the competitors' lowest advertised rates while on sale on Booking.com. This is an asking rate, not ADR (room revenue divided by rooms sold).
advertised.sub: Median of {count, plural, one {# competitor} other {# competitors}} with a rate
advertised.none: No competitor has a rate yet

fill.title: Fill indicator on Booking.com (experimental) ≈
fill.info: Share of the rooms that Booking.com sells for competitors that are no longer on sale (median of {count, plural, one {# competitor} other {# competitors}} with enough data). Closing sales or restrictions also push it up. This is not hotel occupancy: rooms sold elsewhere, groups and direct guests are not visible.
fill.calibrated: error vs PMS ±{mae} pts ({count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}})
fill.notEnough: not enough room data to estimate

trends.title: Comp set trends
trends.info: Comp avg rate is the median of competitors' lowest advertised rates per night on Booking.com. Fill ≈ is an experimental indicator from rooms left on Booking.com, not occupancy.

tightness.title: Current market tightness
tightness.info: Two sources shown separately, never merged into one score. The coloured bar is the competitors' fill indicator ≈ (shared scale: high from {high}, moderate from {moderate}). The diamond is competitors sold out or with ≤3 rooms left out of those observed; orange at half or more, faded with fewer than {min} competitors (small sample).
tightness.legendTight: Competitors sold out or nearly x/N (faded: fewer than {min})
tightness.notForecast: Current state from the latest scans. This is not a forecast.
tightness.restrictedTitle: {count} competitors restricted (not counted as sold out)

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.info: Latest scan collected no data, your hotel sold out or nearly, competitors with ≤3 rooms left. Rate suggestions, tight nights and competitors sold out tonight are in “Today's actions”.
alerts.more: and {count, plural, one {# more alert} other {# more alerts}}
alerts.runFailed: The latest scan collected no data
alerts.ownSoldOut: Your hotel is sold out {when, select, tonight {tonight} other {on {night}}}
alerts.ownLow: Your hotel has only {count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} left {when, select, tonight {tonight} other {on {night}}}
alerts.compSoldOut: {name} is sold out {when, select, tonight {tonight} other {on {night}}}
alerts.compLow: {name} has only {count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} left {when, select, tonight {tonight} other {on {night}}}

yourHotel.title: Your hotel
yourHotel.empty: Your hotel is not on the watchlist yet. <link>Add it in Settings</link>
yourHotel.info: Occupancy comes from your PMS once imported; otherwise it is a fill indicator estimated from rooms left (≈). The rate is your lowest advertised rate on Booking.com, compared with the competitor median. Being cheaper is only flagged when the night is tight.
yourHotel.occCaption: {source, select, pms {occupancy (PMS)} est {fill indicator ≈} other {occupancy}} {when, select, tonight {tonight} other {on {night}}}

dataStatus.title: Data status
dataStatus.info: Latest data = the last successful Booking.com page read (not the last finished scan). Also shows the next scheduled scan and the 7-day page-read success rate (sold out counts as success; blocked and errors do not).
dataStatus.latestEmpty: The scan that finished {when} collected no data
dataStatus.stale: No fresh Booking.com data for over {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
